title: Autonomy declaration
description: The owner's standing approvals for one agent client, declared once under .ai/repo/autonomy/ for every machine that works on the repository: each approval with its date and the rule exactly as the client's auto-mode classifier reads it, the environment lines the classifier is told, and the few top-level settings beside them. `majordomus autonomy approvals` compares a machine's user settings with it, and `majordomus autonomy apply` writes what that machine lacks. Nothing secret belongs here.

schema.description: The format version of this object. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The declaration's identity within the kind.

client.description: The client whose permission layer reads it.

settings.description: Top-level settings beside the approvals. Narrow on purpose: nothing that decides a permission mode, a hook or a guard.

rule.description: The rule exactly as the classifier reads it, beginning 'Owner standing approval (<date>' and quoting the owner's words.

environment.description: The lines the auto-mode classifier is told about the environment.
